answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake, slashed when signed actions are proven to break protocol through an impartial dispute process. A sybil attacker may create endless keys, but each one ties up capital and coordinated abuse risks losing it, so fake identities cannot cheaply multiply influence. The ocean of possible keys is constrained by real value at risk, not a grove of trusted gatekeepers or a plume of account checks.
